title: FMBE 枪械命令包 · 66 狐狸
subtitle: 基于当前 124 命令方块存档；单人纯命令；含换弹/弹药
notes: 召唤、渲染、循环逻辑分别安装；不要把独立按钮串成链。
先完成三个记分板目标创建，手持雪球并执行初始化。
渲染只安装一次，跟随/动作检测/开火链每 tick 运行。
全局清理按钮保存在原文参考包，没有默认加入新工程。
持物预览为源码几何对照，不等同本轮网易实机验证。

sections.title: 00 新世界前置：只执行一次

items.label: P001
items.note: 已有目标提示已存在是正常情况；不要将此块接成有条件链

items.label: G01-001
items.cmd: execute if entity @a[tag=换弹] run playanimation @e[type=fox,name=g2674faf,tag=g2674faf] animation.player.riding.arms none 0 "((v.k111??0)==0)?{v.k110=0;v.k111=1;};return 1;" g2674fat23

items.label: G02-001
items.cmd: execute if entity @a[tag=testa,tag=!休止] run playanimation @e[type=fox,name=g2674faf,tag=g2674faf] animation.player.riding.arms none 0 "v.k90=0;return 1;" g2674fat22

items.label: G03-001
items.cmd: execute if entity @a[tag=g2674fap,tag=testc,c=1,tag=!休止] run playanimation @e[type=fox,name=g2674faf,tag=g2674faf] animation.player.holding.zombie none 0 "v.k90=2;return 1;" g2674fat22

items.label: G04-001
items.cmd: execute if entity @a[tag=g2674fap,tag=testb,c=1,tag=!休止] run playanimation @e[type=fox,name=g2674faf,tag=g2674faf] animation.player.riding.arms.zombie none 0 "v.k90=1;return 1;" g2674fat22

items.label: G05-003
items.cmd: execute unless entity @a[tag=g2674fap] as @a[hasitem={item=snowball}] at @s run tp @e[type=fox,tag=g2674faf] ~~50~

items.label: G05-007
items.cmd: execute as @a[tag=g2674fap] at @s anchored feet unless entity @s[r=0.03] as @s at @s unless block ~ ~ ~ water 0 unless block ~ ~ ~ lava 0 unless entity @s[y=~1.82,dy=0] if entity @s[y=~1.80,dy=0] run tag @s add 移动

items.label: G05-008
items.cmd: execute as @a[tag=g2674fap] at @s unless entity @s[y=~1.5,dy=0] if entity @s[y=~0.7,dy=0] run tag @s add 潜行

items.label: G05-009
items.cmd: execute as @a[tag=g2674fap] at @s if block ~~-0.1~ air 0 run tag @s add 跳跃

items.label: G05-010
items.cmd: execute as @a[tag=!移动] if entity @s[tag=移动2] run tag @s add 回调

items.label: G05-011
items.cmd: execute as @a[tag=!潜行] if entity @s[tag=潜行2] run tag @s add 回调

items.label: G05-013
items.cmd: execute as @a[tag=移动,tag=!移动2] run tag @s[tag=!跳跃,tag=!回调] add testb

items.label: G05-015
items.cmd: execute as @a[tag=潜行,tag=!潜行2] run tag @s[tag=!跳跃] add testc

items.label: G11-004

items.label: G11-005

items.label: G11-006

items.label: G11-007
items.cmd: execute if score test fire matches 1..6 run scoreboard players remove test fire 1

items.label: G11-008
items.cmd: execute if score test fire matches 1..6 run tag @a[tag=g2674fap,tag=!潜行,tag=!休止] add 回调

items.label: G11-009

items.label: G11-012

items.label: G11-013
items.cmd: execute if entity @e[type=snowball] as @a[scores={ammo=0..30},tag=!休止] run titleraw @s actionbar {"rawtext":[{"translate":"%%3","with":{"rawtext":[{"selector":"@s[scores={ammo=0..19}]"},{"selector":"@s[scores={ammo=0..9}]"},{"text":"§4"},{"text":"§6"},{"text":"§r"}]}},{"score":{"name":"@s","objective":"ammo"}}]}
